"Bark, Battle and Ball" is an R&B song recorded by the American band The Platters, and released in June 1955. It originally appeared as the B-side to The Platters hit "Only You". Later, in 1959, the song made its first album appearance on Encores!, released by Wing Records.
It is an answer song to the Bill Haley and His Comets version of "Shake, Rattle and Roll".
Lead vocals
Most of the classic hits by The Platters during the 1950s were sung by Tony Williams.  However, due to the fact that the response needed to be sung from a female perspective, the lead vocals were handled instead by fellow bandmate Zola Taylor.
